info.cls_ename: Department of Fiber and Composite Materials

description.describe_ch: 本課程除了建立學生對複合材料基本的概念外，並對複合材料的各種加工方法與應用做一探討。 完成此一課程同學將可了解複合材料的基本製造原理與方法及各種加工製程之特點。
description.describe_eh: The aims of this course are to establish the basic concepts of composite materials and to investigate the manufacturing process and applications of composite materials. When students complete this course, s/he should be able to understand the fundamental principle of manufacturing method and the feature of various composite process.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解何謂複合材料，且能夠描述複合材料之特點
targets.describe_en: Understand what composite materials are and be able to describe the advantage properties of composite materials.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解複合材料之基本製造原理
targets.describe_en: Understand the basic principle of composite processes.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解複合材料之各種加工技術及其原理，並能應用複合材料之各種加工方法
targets.describe_en: Understand the technology and principles of composite processes. And application the various manufacturing method of composite materials.

targets.describe_ch: 訓練學生能和同儕、及教師討論相關作業問題之解答
targets.describe_en: Training the students can to discuss the solution procedures for homework problems with classmates, and the instructor.
